title: Instrumentation of Perez's Onward and Imperial brass bands
summary: Durand describes the instruments in Perez's street band, saxophones in later days, and the Imperial confusion.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation
